purpose: The service provides a web console for agents to manage customers, including searching, viewing profiles, resetting second-factor authentication, issuing goodwill credits, and exporting customer data.

components.name: console-backend
components.evidence: console-backend is the thing behind the Support web console.

components.name: console-db
components.evidence: everything the agent does goes to agent_action in console-db (postgres)

components.name: keycloak
components.evidence: token check via keycloak, nothing new

flows.evidence: everything the agent does goes to agent_action in console-db (postgres)
token check via keycloak, nothing new

GET /v1/customers (id, full_name, email, phone_number, status), GET /v1/customers/{id}, POST /v1/customers/{id}/second-factor-reset (reason, ticket_id -> id, status), POST /v1/customers/{id}/credits (amount, currency, reason, ticket_id -> id, amount, currency, status), GET /v1/agent-actions (id, agent_id, action, created_at), POST /v1/customers/{id}/data-export (format, reason -> id, status, expires_at)
